title: GenomeRSE
description: A research-software-engineering portfolio project spanning packaged Python/R bioinformatics libraries (VCF annotation, a minimal FHIR R4 validator, an RNA-seq differential expression workflow), an async FHIR R4 MolecularSequence REST API, a JBrowse2 genome-browser plugin for structural-variant visualization, an MLOps Kubernetes stack (MLflow model registry, FastAPI serving, Helm/kind, GitHub Actions CI/CD, Terraform IaC), and original, externally-verifiable contributions building on them.
